title: FEDformer: Frequency-domain decomposition improves forecasting on strongly periodic signals in ETTh1, ETTh2
abstract: We study long-horizon multivariate forecasting using FEDformer, a frequency-enhanced decomposition transformer. On ETTh1, ETTh2, at horizon 336, Frequency-domain decomposition improves forecasting on strongly periodic signals in ETTh1, ETTh2. FEDformer reduces MSE by 12% over time-domain baselines on ETTh1. We discuss two limitations: Attention weights are not analysed, leaving the interpretability claims unverified. Hyperparameters are tuned per-dataset, which advantages larger models that can absorb the added capacity.
